categories.main_business_segments: ZoomInfo operates primarily as a provider of modern go-to-market software, data, and intelligence for sales, marketing, operations, and recruiting teams. Its platform, RevOS, is structured into three layers: Intelligence (data and analytics), Orchestration (data enrichment and workflow automation), and Engagement (tools for outreach and communication). The company’s main product platforms are SalesOS, MarketingOS, OperationsOS, and RecruitingOS.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: ZoomInfo’s platform leverages artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) to aggregate, standardize, verify, and enrich data from millions of sources in real time. The company combines automated data processing with a proprietary human-in-the-loop approach, using research analysts and data scientists to ensure data quality, accuracy, and to address gaps that technology alone cannot solve. Integration with customer CRM and marketing automation systems is a key feature.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ZoomInfo serves a large and diversified customer base across industries such as software, business services, manufacturing, telecommunications, financial services, media, transportation, education, hospitality, and real estate. Customers range from large global enterprises to mid-market and small businesses, with a significant presence in the software and business services sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Vancouver, Washington, with additional offices across the United States and international locations in Israel and the United Kingdom. While the majority of revenue is generated in the United States, approximately 11% of revenue in 2021 came from customers and partners outside the U.S.
categories.supply_chain_position: ZoomInfo operates as a downstream provider in the supply chain, delivering end-user SaaS solutions and data intelligence directly to business customers. It does not manufacture physical goods but aggregates and processes data for use in sales, marketing, and recruiting workflows.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: ZoomInfo’s strategic priorities include continuous innovation in AI/ML-powered data gathering and enrichment, expanding the breadth and depth of its intelligence platform, and integrating new features and capabilities through both internal R&D and selective acquisitions. The company emphasizes enhancing its platform’s integration with customer systems and maintaining high data accuracy and compliance with evolving data privacy regulations.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates the vast majority (approximately 99%) of its revenue from subscription-based services, with customers paying for access to its SaaS platform and data. Subscriptions are typically billed annually, semi-annually, or quarterly in advance, and revenue is recognized ratably over the contract term. A small portion of revenue comes from recurring usage-based services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ZoomInfo positions itself as a comprehensive leader in go-to-market intelligence platforms, claiming broader and deeper offerings than competitors. Key competitors include LinkedIn Sales Navigator, D&B Hoovers, TechTarget, and various niche or legacy data providers. The company also faces potential competition from large enterprise software vendors such as Salesforce, Oracle, Google, and Microsoft/LinkedIn.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: ZoomInfo reported $747.2 million in revenue for the year ended December 31, 2021, representing 57% year-over-year growth. The company has experienced rapid organic and acquisition-driven growth, with a net annual retention rate of 116% in 2021 and over 25,000 customers. Adjusted EBITDA for 2021 was $318.2 million, and the company has transitioned from net losses in prior years to profitability in 2021.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ZoomInfo’s value proposition centers on delivering highly accurate, comprehensive, and actionable business intelligence that enables customers to shorten sales cycles and increase win rates. The company differentiates itself through the scale and quality of its data, real-time updates, integration capabilities, and a platform that combines AI/ML automation with human expertise to guarantee at least 95% data accuracy.
